# Set Up
## Import Packages
```{r, message = FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load Data
```{r}
data = read.csv("/Volumes/Achieve/R03/aidelarazan/GitHub_OSF/Scene360Recall/Data/sub-all_task-Scene360Recall_desc-Data.csv")
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

# 0 = immediate, 1 = one-week delay
data$Session <- data$Session - 1
# center age so the intercept is interpretable
data$Age_c <- data$Age - mean(data$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```
# Behavioral Recall

```{r}
for (dv in c("AI_InternalDetailsProportion", "DescriptionSimilarity", "ConsensusSimilarity", "WordCount")) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ Session + Age_c + (1|Subject) + (1|Scene)"))
  cat("\n===", dv, "===\n")
  print(round(summary(lmer(f, data = data))$coefficients, 5))
}
```

# MTL-Behavior Relationships 
```{r}
for (dv in c("AI_InternalDetailsProportion", "DescriptionSimilarity", "ConsensusSimilarity", "WordCount")) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ MTL * Session + Age_c + (1|Subject) + (1|Scene)"))
  m <- lmer(f, data = data)

  cat("\n===", dv, "===\n")
  cat("\n-- Fixed effects --\n")
  print(round(summary(m)$coefficients, 5))

  cat("\n-- Simple slopes --\n")
  print(as.data.frame(
    emtrends(m, ~ Session, var = "MTL", at = list(Session = c(0, 1))),
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
}
```
```{r}
data_selfconsistency <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SelfConsistency)) %>%
  group_by(Subject, Scene) %>%
  summarise(SelfConsistency = first(SelfConsistency),
            Hippocampus = first(Hippocampus),
            ERC  = first(ERC),
            PRC  = first(PRC),
            PHC  = first(PHC),
            MTL  = first(MTL),
            Age  = first(Age),
            .groups = "drop")

data_selfconsistency$Age_c <- data_selfconsistency$Age - mean(data_selfconsistency$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
local({
  m_selfconsistency <- lmer(SelfConsistency ~ MTL + Age_c + (1|Subject) + (1|Scene),
                            data = data_selfconsistency)
  cat("\n=== SelfConsistency ===\n")
  cat("\n-- Fixed effects --\n")
  print(round(summary(m_selfconsistency)$coefficients, 5))
})
```
# Exploratory: MTL Subregions-Behavior Relationships
```{r, message = FALSE}
regions <- c("Hippocampus", "ERC", "PRC", "PHC")
stopifnot(all(regions %in% names(data)))

dvs <- c("AI_InternalDetailsProportion", "DescriptionSimilarity", "ConsensusSimilarity", "WordCount")

run_dv <- function(dv) {
  fits <- lapply(regions, function(r) {
    f <- as.formula(paste0(dv, " ~ ", r,
                           " * Session + Age_c + (1|Subject) + (1|Scene)"))
    lmer(f, data = data)
  })
  names(fits) <- regions

  # main effect of region, averaged over both sessions
  main_region <- bind_rows(lapply(regions, function(r) {
    s <- summary(emtrends(fits[[r]], ~ 1, var = r,
                          at = list(Session = c(0, 1))),
                 infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
    data.frame(Region = r,
               b  = s[[grep("\\.trend$", names(s))]],
               SE = s$SE, df = s$df, t = s$t.ratio, p = s$p.value)
  }))
  main_region$p_FDR <- p.adjust(main_region$p, method = "BH")
  main_region <- main_region %>% arrange(p)

  # main effect of session, at average volume
  main_session <- bind_rows(lapply(regions, function(r) {
    s <- as.data.frame(contrast(
      emmeans(fits[[r]], ~ Session, at = list(Session = c(0, 1))),
      "revpairwise"))
    data.frame(Region = r, contrast = s$contrast,
               b = s$estimate, SE = s$SE, df = s$df,
               t = s$t.ratio, p = s$p.value)
  }))

  # interaction terms + FDR
  inter <- bind_rows(lapply(regions, function(r) {
    co  <- summary(fits[[r]])$coefficients
    row <- paste0(r, ":Session")
    data.frame(Region = r,
               b  = co[row, "Estimate"],
               SE = co[row, "Std. Error"],
               df = co[row, "df"],
               t  = co[row, "t value"],
               p  = co[row, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  }))
  inter$p_FDR <- p.adjust(inter$p, method = "BH")
  inter <- inter %>% arrange(p)

  # simple slopes at each session
  slopes <- bind_rows(lapply(regions, function(r) {
    et <- as.data.frame(emtrends(fits[[r]], ~ Session, var = r,
                                 at = list(Session = c(0, 1))),
                        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
    names(et)[names(et) == paste0(r, ".trend")] <- "slope"
    et$Region <- r
    et
  })) %>% select(Region, Session, slope, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL, t.ratio, p.value)

  cat("\n\n========== ", dv, " ==========\n")
  cat("\n-- Main effect of region (FDR across 4 regions) --\n"); print(main_region, digits = 3)
  cat("\n-- Main effect of session --\n");                       print(main_session, digits = 3)
  cat("\n-- Interaction (FDR across 4 regions) --\n");           print(inter, digits = 3)
  cat("\n-- Simple slopes --\n");                                print(slopes, digits = 3)

  invisible(list(main_region = main_region, main_session = main_session,
                 inter = inter, slopes = slopes))
}

out <- lapply(dvs, run_dv)
names(out) <- dvs
```

```{r}
regions <- c("Hippocampus","ERC","PRC","PHC")

local({
  selfconsistency_res <- bind_rows(lapply(regions, function(r) {
    f <- as.formula(paste0("SelfConsistency ~ ", r, " + Age_c + (1|Subject) + (1|Scene)"))
    co <- summary(lmer(f, data = data_selfconsistency))$coefficients
    data.frame(Region = r,
               b  = co[r,"Estimate"], SE = co[r,"Std. Error"],
               df = co[r,"df"], t = co[r,"t value"], p = co[r,"Pr(>|t|)"])
  }))
  selfconsistency_res$p_FDR <- p.adjust(selfconsistency_res$p, method = "BH")
  cat("\n\n==========  SelfConsistency  ==========\n")
  cat("\n-- Main effect (FDR across 4 regions) --\n")
  print(selfconsistency_res %>% arrange(p), digits = 3)
})
```
